messages:
Mira: Quick follow-up on the multi-region handshake RFC — can we simplify by moving tenant locality decision to the edge proxy (LB) rather than the central control plane? Thinking fewer cross-region calls and simpler cutovers.

Juan: That'd reduce control-plane load + fewer round trips, but how do we handle legal residency (EU-only) where we must ensure data never leaves region? :thinking_face:

Olivia: Edge can enforce soft-constraints (reject if not resident) but needs a policy sync. My worry is policy drift during gradual rollouts — stale cache means silently serving wrong region.

Ryan: Two high-level options:
- Edge-only: proxy picks region based on header/geo + local policy cache.
- Hybrid: proxy picks candidate, control-plane validates asynchronously and issues eviction/tombstone orders.

Mira: Hybrid seems safer: edge picks candidate and serves immediately to avoid latency regressions; control-plane validates and issues signed attest. If validation fails -> mark tenant tombstoned on edge + async migrate or fail-safe.

Juan: What about ordering/consistency for in-flight requests if we evict? Edge has KV cache for prefixes; we need a clear protocol to flush or demarcate TTL so we don't serve stale writes.

Olivia: Proposal for a minimal header handshake so downstream services can observe handshake state:

````
X-Redwood-Region-Candidate: eu-west-1
X-Redwood-Handshaked: 1
````

Edge sets candidate; control-plane returns a signed attest (short-lived JWT) that the edge can stash.

Ryan: Signed attest makes sense. Attest payload: tenant_id, region, issued_at, exp, sig. Keep it small (<1k) so we don't bloat headers.

Mira: Rollout plan sketch: start with read-only tenants, canary 1% traffic edge-handoff mode, attest beacon every 5s, watch mismatch_rate and request_fallthrough. If mismatch_rate > 0.5% rollback.

Juan: Monitoring (initial):
- handshake.mismatch_rate
- handshake.attest_latency_p50_p95
- handshake.eviction_count
- handshake.policy_staleness_count

Olivia: Ops playbook draft: if control-plane unreachable, edges use last-known attest for 10m then fall back to configured fallback-region per-tenant. Expose feature flag per-tenant to opt into hybrid.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: edge-proxy v1.3.2 -> canary 5% today 18:00 UTC :rocket:.

Ryan: Security: attest must be signed by control-plane KMS keys; verify signature on edge. Key rotation path required (grace period + accepted old sigs for 1h).

Mira: Action items: Juan -> policy-sync patch + TTL semantics; Olivia -> metrics + feature flag; Ryan -> attest signing + key rotation; Mira -> rollout doc + canary checklist. I'll open follow-up RFC/PR and tag infra.

Juan: Sounds good :thumbsup:

Olivia: I'll add the graphs to the console dashboard.

Ryan: LGTM, will start the attest PoC.

Mira: Thanks all — will post the RFC link once up.
